title: cynoglossum ochroleucum
intro: Cynoglossum ochroleucum, commonly known as the white-tongued hound's-tongue, is a flowering plant species in the borage family, Boraginaceae. The health benefits of Cynoglossum ochroleucum include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. Therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe and calm the body, as well as its potential to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Cynoglossum ochroleucum include alkaloids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
